selection: Among 121 predeclared pairs with nonzero acceptance and both empirical CALIB lemma+POS and declared-feature precision >=92%, maximize accepted words; then feature precision, lemma precision, lower threshold sum, lower lemma threshold
infeasible: Keep config null; report failure without enlarging the grid or changing the target
scope: Abstention only; freeze A1 E05 and identity A3 E00; retain legacy full-path separation gate
denominator: All nonpunctuation orthographic units, including unaligned and unresolved projections
limitations: CALIB is selected on and is not an independent test
92% conditional precision is not 92% all-word accuracy or coverage
Full morpheme-path accuracy and actual BPE routing are not measured
Two V copies share the same physical drive
